item.statement: The candidate must preserve row-major [height,pitch] binary32 layout, i32 scalar parameters, and logical width-by-height coverage with pitch used only as stride.

plans.objective: Verify shape, rank, layout, and type of the future candidate interface.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact and read the kernel signature and indexing expressions.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff odata is treated as row-major binary32 with row stride pitch and the logical write set is exactly width columns by height rows, independent of padded columns.
plans.setup: Inspect the candidate parameter declarations, buffer view type, and index arithmetic (row stride pitch, column bound width, row bound height).
